summary: Quantum Cyber N.V. filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026 reporting entry into an at-the-market sales agreement with Titan Partners Securities LLC as sales agent, permitting sales of up to $100,000,000 of ordinary shares from time to time under its Form S-3 shelf (File No. 333-296480, effective June 15, 2026), via a Rule 424(b) prospectus supplement. Proceeds are earmarked for motor, propeller and quantum antenna capital expenditures, operating-system software development, capacity expansion, potential acquisitions or strategic investments, and working capital. This is a routine shelf takedown facility, not a special situation; no price, premium or closing terms are stated. Watch dilution pace and any strategic-use deployment.
